Hi,

one short question as i am not sure about this:

Flames of Insurrection
Unique master. Requires a ready anarch.
Put this card in play. When a minion opposing an anarch in combat leaves the ready region, the controller of that anarch may move a counter from the bank to a vampire in his or her uncontrolled region. Any vampire may call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.

Lets say 2 anarch vampires are in combat, both go to torpor. Can both players use this card to put a counter on an uncontrolled vampire?

thanks!
